transformation.description: Exact named captured SHA-256 map containers become algorithm-typed ordered [digest, path] records, with every plaintext digest and path unchanged. Declared public fixture fields are first validated against exact actual synthetic fixture bytes. Native source/vendor, complete850 quality, current173 Unit and174 active-source maps are actually rehashed against their known frozen snapshots. The Functional map retains498 recorded inputs with only its75 production inputs actually rehashed; historical295 Native maps retain only captured-metadata meaning. No unknown field or unpinned original is converted.
